open_points.subject: 01_models.md:Model M08 — Refusal
open_points.text:
A delivery is M08 for the refusals of
A3 rule 4 and A6 rules 1 and 5, and M06 for the failures of A3 rule 5.
open_points.question: Which product action and refusal condition does the newly added reference to A6 rule 1 denote, so implementers know which action creates or returns M08?
options: A6 rule 1 is a whole-operation refusal of Record the publication and returns M08
A6 rule 1 belongs to another product action whose refusal returns M08
The A6 rule 1 reference is erroneous and must classify no outcome
open_points.default_guess: Treat A6 as Record the publication and A6 rule 1 as a whole-operation refusal returning M08.
